Author: K. Lakshman
Bench: K. Lakshman
 The Honourable Sri Justice K. Lakshman
 Crimminal Petition No.5652 Of 2020
Order:

This application is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. to quash the proceedings in C.C. No.5 of 2018,
pending on the file of the Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Husnabad, Karimnagar District, against petitioners - accused Nos.1 to 3.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Husnabad, Karimnagar District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioners are Accused Nos.1 to 3 in the said case.

The offences alleged against them are under Sections 270 and 273 of IPC.
2.

The learned counsel for the petitioners as well as the learned Assistant Public Prosecutor would submit that the subject matter is squarely covered by a common order dated 27.08.2018, passed by the High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the States of Telangana and Andhra Pradesh in Crl.P.
No.3731 of 2018 and batch, and placed copy of the said judgment for perusal.

entities.text: High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
3. Perused the common order dated 27.08.2018 in Crl.P. No.3731 of 2018, wherein a learned Single Judge of the High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the States of Telangana and Andhra Pradesh following the guidelines laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in State of Haryana v. Bhajan Lal1,
held that the police are incompetent to take cognizance of the offences punishable under Sections 54 and 59 (1) of the Food Safety and Standards (FSS) Act, 2006, investigating into the offences along with other offences under 1992 Supp. (1) SCC 335 the provisions of IPC and filing charge sheet is a grave illegality, as the Food Safety Officer alone is competent to investigate and to file charge sheet following the Rules laid down under Sections 41 and 42 of FSS Act.
4.

entities.text: High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: State of Haryana v. Bhajan Lal1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of the above submission, the present Criminal Petition is disposed of in terms of the common order dated 27.08.2018 in Crl.P. No.3731 of 2018 and batch.

In view of the same, liberty is granted to the petitioners to file an application under Section 452 Cr.P.C., and the Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Husnabad, Karimnagar District, shall consider the same in accordance with law.
